releaseNotes: - Fixed: customers past the 500th were saved but missing from the Customers list and search. Every customer now appears; no record was changed.
- Package billing restored: Confirm Bill > PRICING > One Price for Whole Order. Reopened package orders keep their agreed price.
- New SC/GVT payment options: SC FIRST, GVT FIRST, SC PAID, GVT PAID.
- New fabric selection workspace; the stock warning while choosing fabric is removed (the after-save shortage warning remains).
- Sleeve Gheer is one figure; Half Sleeve added. Measurement slip layout updated.
- The order-screen Sale Offer button is now labelled 'fabric + stitching'.
